source.publication: 2025 Montana Individual Income Tax Return Form 2 and Form 2 Instructions
source.section: Form 2 PDF p1 lines 1-8 and PDF p2 worksheet lines 1-13; Instructions PDF p12-13 lines 1-8; PDF p17 tax calculation; PDF p18 rate tables; Instructions PDF p28 Lines 22 and 23, Railroad Retirement Benefits; Form 2 PDF p3 lines 22-24; record reliefs railroad_retirement_subtraction; Instructions PDF p13 Line 6, $5,660 subtraction for taxpayers 65 and older; Form 2 PDF p1 line 6; record base.deductions age_65_subtraction

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 1) 50,000.00 + railroad retirement (person 0) 18,000.00 + railroad retirement (person 0) 6,000.00 = 74,000.00. Federal taxable income = 74,000.00 - standard deduction 33,100.00 (31,500.00 + 1 x 1,600.00 for 65 or older) = 40,900.00 (federal senior deduction ignored, although Montana's line 2 would take it). Filing status married filing jointly, no Montana standard deduction or exemptions. Schedule I Part I: line 7 additions 0.00; lines 22 and 23 railroad retirement 24,000.00; line 24 subtractions 24,000.00. Form 2 page 1: line 1 federal AGI 74,000.00; line 2 Form 1040 lines 12e and 13b 33,100.00; line 3 40,900.00; line 4 0.00; line 5 24,000.00; line 6 age 65 subtraction 1 x 5,660.00 = 5,660.00; line 7 Montana taxable income 40,900.00 + 0.00 - 24,000.00 - 5,660.00 = 11,240.00. Page 2 worksheet: line 1 taxable income 11,240.00; no net long-term capital gain, so lines 2-10 are skipped and line 11 is 0.00; line 12 ordinary income tax from the PDF p18 rate table: 4.7% x 11,240.00 = 528.28; line 13 = 528.28, carried to page 1 line 8. Bracket schedule as numbers (the expected figure): 4.7% x 11,240.00 = 528.28. Line 9 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 10 tax after credits 528.28. The 18,000.00 item is Tier II (Form 1040 line 5b, Schedule I line 23). The 6,000.00 item is the Tier I amount included on Form 1040 line 6b (Schedule I line 22), given as a railroad_retirement item because the inputs have no Tier I field. Both are subtracted.
